findings.issue: Head::read did not require the first metadata block at byte 4 to be STREAMINFO (type 0), accepted duplicate STREAMINFO blocks, accepted STREAMINFO blocks with len > 34, accepted reserved metadata block types (7..=127) in the leading metadata loop, and omitted RFC 9639 §8.2 block-size bounds validation (min_block >= 16, max_block >= 16, min_block <= max_block).
Flac::parse_owned_controlled only checked head.max_frame == largest when head.min_frame != 0, and did not verify channel_mask.count_ones() <= channels for explicit Vorbis-comment speaker masks.

Matroska FLAC setup omitted STREAMINFO block-size bounds validation (min_block >= 16, max_block >= 16, min_block <= max_block) and accepted Vorbis-comment speaker masks whose popcount exceeded channels (matched in src/codec/flac_decoder.rs and src/playback/audio/webm_audio.rs).
